The '''Verkuyl system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Dakuyl]] and [[Verkuyl]].
